misconceptions.description: Leaving title rows, blank rows, or banner text above the header row so the data range does not start cleanly
misconceptions.trigger: learner keeps a report title or blank row stacked on top of the header row
misconceptions.feedback: Put a single header row at the top with no title or blank rows above it. Move the title to a chart or a cell off to the side so features read the columns correctly.

misconceptions.description: Typing currency symbols or unit words inside number cells so values are stored as text and skipped by SUM and AVERAGE
misconceptions.trigger: learner enters values like '$1,250.00' or '1250 USD' directly in the cell
misconceptions.feedback: Store the raw number and apply currency or unit formatting through cell format. Text values are ignored by math functions.

misconceptions.description: Packing more than one fact into a single cell, such as last and first name together, so columns cannot be sorted or used independently
misconceptions.trigger: learner keeps combined values like 'Lopez, Maria' in one column
misconceptions.feedback: Split combined values so each cell holds one fact. Use Text to Columns so each piece can be sorted, filtered, or referenced on its own.

misconceptions.description: Letting the same category appear under several spellings or cases so summaries split one group into many
misconceptions.trigger: learner summarizes a column with values like 'TX', 'Tx', 'texas', and 'Texas'
misconceptions.feedback: Standardize category labels to one spelling and case before any pivot or chart so each real group counts as one category.
